title: The Instant Wallet Send

context.platform: Web page in Chromium at phone size; passkey = Chromium virtual authenticator
context.settings: defaults; first send, which also deploys the wallet

captures.note: dry: home → send form → review card; stopped before Send

_comment: Two hosts answer the browser besides the wallet's own: pulse.walletconnect.org and euc.li. Everything else goes to instantwallet.io, which calls Alchemy, Zerion and others from the server; those hops are read from source and marked code. Wallet is a Safe 1.5.0 with a passkey signer; lab wallet 0x34F942e7567CE091CcECA12feA4B4BE67eeDC587. Not captured: the phone (Safari, Face ID, synced passkey), the wedgie, the light client, the node setting.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · the page
steps.purpose: GET / and 22 script/style files. The wallet is a web page: this is the code that builds and shows every transaction

worst_lie.note: every visit runs whatever the server sends; no pinned version, no hash to check

steps.notes: Every push to main deploys (README.md). No release tags, no IPFS build.

steps.name: WalletConnect · telemetry
steps.purpose: POST /batch on every page load: an INIT event with the site, the SDK version and a client_id
steps.notes: device_id = client_id. The same did:key was sent in three runs across browser restarts (warm-20261111-123212, 20261111-123340-home-instant, this run). Fires with no dapp connected.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · wallet name
steps.purpose: GET /api/name?id: the wallet's nickname, stored encrypted under an id made from the passkey's credential id
steps.notes: device_id = the opaque id. The server sees ciphertext only, but the id is the same on every device the passkey syncs to.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · RPC proxy
steps.purpose: POST /api/rpc/<chain>: eth_getCode(your wallet) on all 14 networks, and alchemy_getAssetTransfers on 11
steps.returns: is the wallet deployed here; its transfer history

worst_lie.note: wrong history, or a deployed wallet shown as not deployed

steps.notes: eth_getCode on all 14 networks about every 12 s while the page is open. A per-IP counter runs in the server's memory (route.ts:24-37).

steps.name: Instant Wallet · balances + prices
steps.purpose: GET /api/portfolio?address: tokens, balances, logos and prices on every network
steps.returns: what the wallet holds and what it's worth

worst_lie.note: wrong balance or price on screen; the amount box is in dollars, so a wrong price changes how much ETH you send

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · GET /api/portfolio (query not logged; address per SafeWelcome.tsx:24)

steps.notes: About 20 a minute idle (20261111-123340-home-instant: 23 in 60 s).

worst_lie.note: a position or NFT shown that isn't there, or hidden

steps.name: Alchemy · behind the server
steps.purpose: The server forwards every /api/rpc body unchanged, and asks Alchemy for token balances, NFTs and prices

worst_lie.note: the server passes Alchemy's answer through unchecked

steps.notes: Not on the wire: the lab sees the browser, not the server. Alchemy sees the server's IP, not yours. eth-mainnet is one of 14 Alchemy network hosts. The node setting moves /api/rpc only; token list, names and prices still come from here (docs/CROPS.md).

steps.name: Zerion · behind the server
steps.purpose: The server asks Zerion for the wallet's positions
steps.notes: Not on the wire. Whether the production server has a Zerion key set was not checked.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · names in your history
steps.purpose: GET /api/ens?address for your wallet and for addresses in its history

worst_lie.note: a wrong name next to an address

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · GET /api/ens ×2 before the send form · app/api/ens/route.ts:26

steps.name: euc.li · avatar of a past sender
steps.purpose: GET /slop.atg.eth: the picture for a name in the wallet's history, loaded by the browser
steps.notes: Which history entry the name belongs to is inferred: the only transfer before this run was the funding one.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · recipient's name
steps.purpose: GET /api/ens?address=<recipient>: the pasted address is looked up for a name

worst_lie.note: a wrong name shown above the address you pasted; the address itself stays on screen

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · GET /api/ens at t+14.8 s, review card shows austingriffith.eth · app/api/ens/route.ts:26

steps.notes: The server resolves on chain through Alchemy mainnet (route.ts:18), so Alchemy sees the recipient too.

steps.name: euc.li · recipient's avatar
steps.purpose: GET /austingriffith.eth: the recipient's picture, loaded by the browser before you sign
steps.notes: A third party learns who you are about to pay, and your IP, before the transaction exists.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · relay fee
steps.purpose: GET /api/safe/relay?chainId&kind: the relay's fee and address

worst_lie.note: the fee it names is paid from the wallet in the batch you sign. The review card shows it; whether the app caps it was not checked

steps.notes: The server prices gas through Alchemy and ETH through api.coinbase.com (lib/safe/relayCore.ts:48); neither call carries user data.

steps.name: Passkey · you sign
steps.host: (local: WebAuthn signature over the Safe transaction hash)
steps.purpose: The passkey signs the hash of a Safe batch: deploy the wallet, pay the recipient, pay the relay fee
steps.returns: a signature only this passkey can make

worst_lie.note: the passkey signs a hash and shows nothing. What you approve is whatever the page built

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · signatures field of POST /api/safe/relay (WebAuthn authenticatorData + clientDataFields) · lib/passkey.ts signDigest

steps.notes: In the lab the passkey is Chromium's virtual authenticator. On a phone it is Face ID with an iCloud- or Google-synced passkey; that sync was not observed.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · relay
steps.purpose: POST /api/safe/relay: the signed Safe transaction. A passkey can't pay gas, so the relay's own key sends it

worst_lie.note: it can refuse or sit on the transaction; it can't change what the passkey signed

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · POST /api/safe/relay {chainId, kind, safe, tx, signatures} · tx 0xdd6bf2e2…b2bb from 0x4cFaB321…8A2f

steps.failure_note: with only a passkey there is no other way to send

fallback.desc: a second owner key that holds gas can execute the same signed transaction (sendSelf in TxPage.tsx, or any Safe tool)
fallback.note: needs a browser-wallet owner; a passkey-only wallet has none

steps.notes: Limited to 240 sends an hour per IP; the counter is kept in the server's key-value store (lib/limit.ts:12).

steps.name: Alchemy · relay's broadcast
steps.purpose: The relay wraps your Safe transaction in its own and sends it with eth_sendRawTransaction

worst_lie.note: can drop it and return a hash anyway

steps.notes: Not on the wire. On chain the sender is the relay 0x4cFaB32186e65E2A39EC0e882e11380cbf2f8A2f and the target is Multicall3.

worst_lie.note: consensus checks the block; they can only exclude or reorder

steps.name: Instant Wallet · RPC proxy, receipt
steps.purpose: POST /api/rpc/1: eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getTransactionByHash, eth_blockNumber, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getLogs

worst_lie.note: can show Executed for a transaction that failed, or the reverse

steps.notes: Forwarded to Alchemy like every /api/rpc call.

steps.name: Instant Wallet · plain-words check
steps.purpose: POST /api/explain {chain, safe, calls}: the server describes the transaction's calls

worst_lie.note: a wrong description on the done screen

provenance.ref: 20261111-185710-send-eth-instant · POST /api/explain at t+19.2 s and t+31.0 s (after the relay POST) · app/api/explain/route.ts

steps.notes: In this run it fired after the send, not before. A call nothing can read is also counted at wedgie.dev/api/misses (route.ts:66).
